query:
-- Full slot list for LSEG (191181016455) and Amazon (452351)
SELECT m.attendeeId, m.timeSlot, s.companyName as bookedWith
FROM meetings m
JOIN sponsors s ON s.id = m.sponsorId
WHERE m.isVisible = 1
  AND m.attendeeId IN ('191181016455', '452351')
ORDER BY m.attendeeId, m.timeSlot;
